summary: Frontend-only verification of the timezone deterministic rendering fix in formatTime() (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx). Seeded a movement via POST /api/tires {size:'185/55 R15', brand:'Michelin', season:'Estive', rim:15, quantity:2, operator:'TZ_TEST'} and verified /api/movements returned timestamp=2026-10-03T19:54:00.696Z. Opened the dashboard four times under different simulated device timezones using Chrome DevTools Protocol Emulation.setTimezoneOverride (Europe/Rome, America/New_York, UTC, Asia/Tokyo), each with a full page.reload(). In all four contexts the TZ_TEST cronologia row rendered the SAME string: '03 ott • 21:54', matching the Europe/Rome local expected value computed via new Date('2026-10-03T19:54:00.696Z').toLocaleString('it-IT',{timeZone:'Europe/Rome',...}). No regression: dashboard renders, operator-name visible ('TZ Tester'), movement rows still show operator chip (TZ_TEST / Marco Rossi) and signed delta (+2 / -1 / +1 / Tot:N).
critical_code_review_comments: formatTime() correctly passes timeZone:'Europe/Rome' to both toLocaleDateString and toLocaleTimeString - verified deterministic rendering across 4 simulated device timezones.
Backend stores Z-suffixed UTC ISO strings as expected (timestamp field confirmed on POST /api/tires and GET /api/movements).
seed_data_creation: POST /api/tires created tire id=ed938175-a2cc-45b8-a0b2-b2ba8f1c71d8 (size 185/55 R15 Michelin Estive, qty 2, operator TZ_TEST) which auto-generated movement id=edd09e20-e20b-4249-9d95-ba35c6b632a5 with timestamp 2026-10-03T19:54:00.696Z. Used to validate TZ-deterministic rendering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To simulate device timezones in the Expo web preview, obtain a CDP session via page.context.new_cdp_session(page) and call cdp.send('Emulation.setTimezoneOverride', {timezoneId:'Europe/Rome'|'America/New_York'|'UTC'|'Asia/Tokyo'}) then page.reload(). The TZ_TEST operator seed row persists in the DB and can be reused for future regression. Welcome screen appears only on fresh localStorage; type a name and click text='Entra'.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: formatTime() previously relied on the device's local timezone, so a UTC timestamp '2026-10-03T19:54:00.696Z' displayed as '21:54' in Rome but as '15:54' in New York on the same movement. Fix (verified): passing timeZone:'Europe/Rome' to toLocaleDateString and toLocaleTimeString forces deterministic Rome-local output. Reproduction (now green): run the dashboard under Europe/Rome, America/New_York, UTC and Asia/Tokyo - all four rendered '03 ott • 21:54' for the same movement, matching the expected Rome-local value computed independently via Intl in the browser.
